content.title: Euphoria': The New Cast Members Joining Season Three And Where You've Seen Them Before
content.text: 1Sharon Stone plays Patty LanceEddy Chen//HBOStone plays Patty Lance, a showrunner who Lexi works under. When she was announced by the official Euphoria social media channels, the caption read: 'She runs the show'. On the announcement, Stone told Variety: 'From the genius of Sam Levinson to the raw sophistication of this profoundly moving cast and tight crew. I am honoured to be Euphoric.'Stone is a bona fide A Lister who has starred in films like Casino and Basic Insinct.2Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje plays Alamo BrownEddy Chen//HBOAkinnuoye-Agbaje's Alamo Brown appeared in the first episode of season three as a strip club owner who also runs drugs and guns and looks to be one of this season's (many?) 'bad guys'. Speaking about Brown in an interview, the actor said: 'At the time we meet him in the show, Brown has arrived at a point in his life where he’s built an empire and he’s always looking to expand it. When he meets Rue, played by the wonderful Zendaya, she offers an opportunity for him to expand his enterprises into the Gen Z digital world. It’s an interesting alliance. He’s always been able to assess people’s qualities; where he can see that he can manipulate to utilise your talents for his own means, he will.' The British actor has previously appeared in shows like Lost and Oz.Advertisement - Continue Reading Below3Jessica Treska plays Daisy MillerMichael Tullberg//Getty ImagesDaisy is one of the earliest new characters we meet, a religious girl who connects with Rue in the first episode of season three. She's previously also appeared in Sharp Objects, Hysteria! and Alex & Me. 4Asante Blackk plays KiddCorey Nickols//Getty ImagesBlackk's Kidd is a runner for Alamo who we meet in the season's first episode. You may recognise him from his role in This Is Us – he also starred in When They See Us.Advertisement - Continue Reading Below5Eli Roth, episode oneCHRIS DELMASDid you catch filmmaker Eli Roth's episode one cameo? It had been something the internet had been confused by – and it was quick as anything. As it turns out, he was the guy in Rue's Uber in the Batman mask. IMDB shows him listed as 'Batman' in the credits for episode one.6Natasha LyonneMatt Winkelmeyer//Getty ImagesLyonne is one of the biggest name signings for season three of Euphoria, but as yet, we don't know what role she'll play. The actress is always riveting on screen though, so we can't wait – you may know her from her roles in shows like Orange Is The New Black, Russian Doll and Pokerface as well as the American Pie films.Advertisement - Continue Reading Below7Danielle DeadwylerChristina HouseAnother unnamed new character, it was announced Deadwyler would join the show; she's revealed that the season is 'everything', so make of that what you will. Deadwyler is also currently starring in another huge HBO show, Rooster, but has previously appeared in films like The Piano Lesson, The Harder They Fall and Till.8Rosalía plays MagickDavid M. Benett//Getty ImagesIt's been reported that the singer plays a stripper called Magick – and you may have glimpsed her in the trailer, pole-dancing with a neck brace on. She revealed to ELLE in February that she will be wearing the neck brace 'for the entire show'. 'At the beginning when I was shooting with it, I was a little bit annoyed,' she said. 'So I had to learn how to love it and live with it. And that was also a learning experience to me in so many ways. It was very, very beautiful and an amazing learning experience.'Advertisement - Continue Reading Below9Trisha PaytasGilbert Flores//Getty ImagesThe social media star, who has more than two million followers, will appear in episode five in her biggest acting role to date. We've yet to be told anything about her character, but it's fair to say anticipation is high. She told People that starring in the show was 'the coolest experience ever'.Sarah Karmali is the Multiplatform Director of Harper’s Bazaar and ELLE UK, overseeing the digital strategy for both brands. Sarah was previously named Digital Content Leader of the Year at the 2017 PPA Awards, and worked on the digital teams at Vogue, Marie Claire, InStyle, and the Huffington Post, covering luxury fashion, beauty and travel content.Read full bio
